artifact.pluginYml:
name: BLWorldTrashCan
version: 7.0.0
main: pixeltech.bluenine.blworldtrashcan.plugin.universal.BLWorldTrashCanUniversalPlugin
api-version: '1.13'
folia-supported: true
softdepend:
  - Vault
  - PlaceholderAPI
commands:
  blworldtrashcan:
    aliases: [blwtc]
    description: BLWorldTrashCan main command.
  worldlisttrashcan:
    aliases: [WorldListTrashCan, WTC, wtc]
    description: Legacy WorldListTrashCan command alias.
permissions:
  blworldtrashcan.admin:
    default: op
  blworldtrashcan.use:
    default: true
  blworldtrashcan.world.create:
    default: true
  blworldtrashcan.global.open:
    default: true
  blworldtrashcan.global.take:
    default: true
  blworldtrashcan.global.put:
    default: true
  blworldtrashcan.personal.open:
    default: true
  blworldtrashcan.personal.take:
    default: true
  blworldtrashcan.personal.put:
    default: true
  blworldtrashcan.dropmode:
    default: true
  blworldtrashcan.look:
    default: true
